content: This foam mattress has been a huge disappointment from day one. It arrived compressed and never fully expanded to the advertised thickness, leaving lumpy, uneven spots all over. The chemical smell was extremely strong and took weeks to fade, making my entire bedroom reek. Instead of being supportive, the mattress sinks badly in the middle, so I wake up with back and hip pain every morning. It also traps heat like an oven, and I find myself sweating even when the room is cool. The edges offer no support at all, so you feel like you’re going to roll off if you sleep near the side. For the price, the quality feels incredibly cheap, from the flimsy cover to the inconsistent foam density. I regret this purchase and will be replacing it as soon as possible.
